name: A stopover on SQ-75
source:
Mixx the Jump Jockey (from the zine of Millie Cool Spaceship Universe) stops by a nameless farm planet with a delivery.

[From [url=https://micpp.itch.io/coolspaceshipvn]Itch.io[/url]]
